scope: Local product relation evidence repair and formal public-evaluation workflow integration; no production deployment or new model calls in this step

productBehavior.sameDocument: A supported relation requires one actual quote instance covering both preserved source locators, with target quote bytes and available source/projection hashes matching the document
productBehavior.crossDocument: Existing single-quote schema cannot establish dual-document support; retain the relation as unresolved
productBehavior.missingEvidence: Save the legal fact, downgrade the unsupported relation to unresolved, and return an explicit Chinese warning and reason in existing results
productBehavior.security: Existing study/patient reference fence remains intact
productBehavior.compatibility: No schema fields, migrations, platform entities or delivery gates added; no DrugProt sentence constraint in product

cases: Same-name different instance stays unresolved while fact saved
Same patient cross-document single quote stays unresolved
Foreign patient target refused by existing fence
Same-document evidence spanning sentences remains supportable

limitations: Source binding verifies evidence placement and preserved bytes, not the clinical truth of the relation
Existing persisted historical relations are not silently rewritten; this repair applies to new writes
Cross-document supported evidence requires a future explicit dual-source contract; this schema retains it unresolved
